timeline.purpose: Show ordered operational, audit, route, support, or maintenance events with grouping, filtering, status, owner, and next action.
useWhen: Users need to understand event sequence and accountability.
Events require grouping by time, actor, entity, or status.
The sequence supports investigation, audit, recovery, or support handoff.
doNotUseWithoutReview: Only one event is needed; use Audit Event.
Ordering, timezone, grouping, or source is unclear.
The timeline implies audit/legal evidence without a confirmed source.
foundations: Defines event spacing, group labels, sticky context, and responsive density.
Owns event titles, timestamps, actor copy, status, and recovery labels.
Controls status tone, current event, warning, and selected state.
Loaded, loading, empty, filtered, current, warning, critical, and verified states are explicit.
Details and filters layer above the timeline without hiding sequence.
Event order, timestamps, status, and grouping are readable without visual position only.
slots: Ordered events with title, description, time, and status.
Date or phase grouping when sequence needs structure.
Status/entity filters that preserve sequence context.
View detail, retry, contact support, or export.
variants: Ordered audit events with actor and status.
Events grouped by route phase or maintenance state.
Empty State appears when filters remove all events.
motion: Event list updates without losing scroll context.
Current marker changes without decorative motion.
Uses Design System overlay behavior when details are needed.
accessibility: Events are ordered in DOM sequence.
Filtering preserves focus and announces empty state.
tests: Empty state appears when no events match.
Status and timestamp remain visible on narrow viewports.

canDecide: Use Timeline when sequence and accountability matter.
Use Audit Event for each atomic event.
Use Empty State for filtered results.
mustAsk: Event source, order, timezone, audit status, or legal meaning is unclear.
The timeline affects compliance, legal, finance, or support evidence.
miel.handoff: Confirm event source, order, timezone, grouping, filters, status language, evidence policy, and detail actions.
